pairs.target: dì shēnqǐng de dìfāng , bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de ǎi .
pairs.english: The place for submitting applications was lower than Tavi had imagined.
pairs.hanzi: 递申请的地方，比塔维想的矮。

pairs.target: tā jiù zài huòzhàn hòumiàn ,
pairs.english: It was right behind the freight station,
pairs.hanzi: 它就在货站后面，

pairs.target: ménshàng méiyǒu bái jiē de shíwén ,
pairs.english: with no White Steps stone pattern on its door,
pairs.hanzi: 门上没有白阶的石纹，

pairs.target: zhǐyǒu yíkuài bèi yǔ pào dé qiào biān de mùpái .
pairs.english: only a wooden sign whose edges had curled from being soaked by rain.
pairs.hanzi: 只有一块被雨泡得翘边的木牌。

pairs.target: nài lěi gàosù tā , zhè shì tì xuégōng shōujiàn de gōngsuǒ ,
pairs.english: Nerai told him this was the office that received documents for the academy;
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾告诉他，这是替学宫收件的公所，

pairs.target: rén hé zhǐ dōu yào xiān zài zhèlǐ děng , zài wǎng shàng sòng .
pairs.english: people and papers both had to wait here first, then be sent farther up.
pairs.hanzi: 人和纸都要先在这里等，再往上送。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jīn zǎo shǎo lǐng le bàn bān huó , shìxiān gēn guǎnshì shuō guò .
pairs.english: Tavi had taken half a shift less work this morning, having told the foreman beforehand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维今早少领了半班活，事先跟管事说过。

pairs.target: sè lā zhīdào shǎo le duōshǎo qián .
pairs.english: Sela knew how much money that meant losing.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉知道少了多少钱。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ zhè tàng suàn chéng búyòng fùqián de kòngxián .
pairs.english: He had not counted this trip as free time that cost nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有把这趟算成不用付钱的空闲。

pairs.target: wūlǐ yǒu sānzhāng chángdèng , zuò zhe de rén gèzì bào zhe bāo .
pairs.english: There were three benches in the room; the people sitting there each held a bag.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里有三张长凳，坐着的人各自抱着包。

pairs.target: yígè nǚhái kào zài fùqīn jiānshàng shuìzháo le ,
pairs.english: A girl had fallen asleep against her father's shoulder,
pairs.hanzi: 一个女孩靠在父亲肩上睡着了，

pairs.target: xiédǐ hái zhān zhe cháng lùshang de huángní .
pairs.english: yellow mud from the long road still clinging to the soles of her shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 鞋底还沾着长路上的黄泥。

pairs.target: guìtái hòu yǒurén fān zhǐ , měi fān yìzhāng biàn yòng zhǐ fù zhàn yíxià shuǐ ,
pairs.english: Behind the counter someone turned papers, wetting a fingertip with water each time she turned a sheet;
pairs.hanzi: 柜台后有人翻纸，每翻一张便用指腹蘸一下水，

pairs.target: shēngyīn zài ānjìng de wūzilǐ géwài qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: the sound was especially clear in the quiet room.
pairs.hanzi: 声音在安静的屋子里格外清楚。

pairs.target: lún dào tǎ wéi , tā jiāng bùdài lǐ de zhǐ yìzhāng zhāng qǔchū .
pairs.english: When Tavi's turn came, he took the papers from his cloth bag one sheet at a time.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到塔维，他将布袋里的纸一张张取出。

pairs.target: zuì shàngmiàn shì zuówǎn liè de wèntí , zài xiàmiàn cái shì tuījiàn .
pairs.english: On top were the questions listed last night; only underneath were the recommendations.
pairs.hanzi: 最上面是昨晚列的问题，再下面才是推荐。

pairs.target: shōujiàn de nǚrén bǎ wèntí zhǐ fàngdào yìbiān , wèn zhùzhǐ .
pairs.english: The woman receiving documents put the question sheet aside and asked his address.
pairs.hanzi: 收件的女人把问题纸放到一边，问住址。

pairs.target: tā bàochū huī ào , yòu shuō le lú chǎng pángbiān de xiàngzi .
pairs.english: He gave Ash Hollow, then named the lane beside the furnace yard.
pairs.hanzi: 他报出灰坳，又说了炉场旁边的巷子。

pairs.target: tā wèn jǐhào mén , tā dá bú shànglái .
pairs.english: She asked which door number; he could not answer.
pairs.hanzi: 她问几号门，他答不上来。

pairs.target: " wǒmen ménshàng méi hào . yǒu yìzhī qué gǒu cháng shuì zài nàlǐ . "
pairs.english: “Our door has no number. A lame dog often sleeps there.”
pairs.hanzi: “我们门上没号。有一只瘸狗常睡在那里。”

pairs.target: nǚrén de bǐ tíngzhù .
pairs.english: The woman's pen stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 女人的笔停住。

pairs.target: nài lěi méi tì tā bǔ , tā zhuǎnshēn kàn xiàng chuāngwài ,
pairs.english: Nerai did not fill in for him; she turned toward the window,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没替他补，她转身看向窗外，

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cái fāxiànzìjǐ yòu bǎ zhǐyǒu shú réncái dǒng de dōngxī dàngchéng dìzhǐ .
pairs.english: and only then did Tavi realize he had again treated something only acquaintances would understand as an address.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维才发现自己又把只有熟人才懂的东西当成地址。

pairs.target: " gǒu bú zài ne ? " nǚrén wèn .
pairs.english: “What if the dog isn't there?” the woman asked.
pairs.hanzi: “狗不在呢？”女人问。

pairs.target: " dìèrdào shuǐgōu shàngmiàn , kào jiù zhuānqiáng de mén . "
pairs.english: “Above the second drain, the door by the old brick wall.”
pairs.hanzi: “第二道水沟上面，靠旧砖墙的门。”

pairs.target: tā ràng tā zài zhǐbèi huà yìxiǎo duàn lù , biāochū zuìjìn de shōuxìn chù .
pairs.english: She had him sketch a short stretch of road on the back of the paper and mark the nearest place for receiving letters.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他在纸背画一小段路，标出最近的收信处。

pairs.target: huī ào méiyǒu xìnxiāng , xìn yìbān fàngzài nán jiē de záhuòpù .
pairs.english: Ash Hollow had no letter box; letters were usually left at the grocery shop on South Steps.
pairs.hanzi: 灰坳没有信箱，信一般放在南阶的杂货铺。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qùguò nà jiā pùzi , tì sè lā mǎi guò yán ,
pairs.english: Tavi had been to that shop and bought salt for Sela,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去过那家铺子，替瑟拉买过盐，

pairs.target: què méi xiǎng guò yǒu yìtiān nàlǐ huì yǒu zìjǐ de xìn .
pairs.english: but had never imagined that one day there would be a letter for him there.
pairs.hanzi: 却没想过有一天那里会有自己的信。

pairs.target: huà wán , tā kànjiàn nǚrén jiāng chūshēng nà yìlán quān le qǐlái .
pairs.english: When he finished drawing, he saw the woman circle the birth entry.
pairs.hanzi: 画完，他看见女人将出生那一栏圈了起来。

pairs.target: " zhèlǐ bùnéng dàngzuò méi kànjiàn . "
pairs.english: “We can't treat this as though we haven't seen it.”
pairs.hanzi: “这里不能当作没看见。”

pairs.target: " wǒ méiyǒu dēngjì . "
pairs.english: “I have no registration.”
pairs.hanzi: “我没有登记。”

pairs.target: nài lěi zhè cái qǔchū lìng yìzhāng zhǐ , qǐng tā yíbìng shōuxià .
pairs.english: Only then did Nerai take out another sheet and ask her to accept it as well.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾这才取出另一张纸，请她一并收下。

pairs.target: nà shì gòng dānbǎorén tiánxiě de shēnfèn shuōmíng ,
pairs.english: It was an identity statement for a sponsor to fill in,
pairs.hanzi: 那是供担保人填写的身份说明，

pairs.target: xiě de shì xiàn zhù dì hé kě héshí de shēnghuó jīnglì , chūshēngdì réng liúkōng .
pairs.english: giving his current residence and verifiable life history; the birthplace remained blank.
pairs.hanzi: 写的是现住地和可核实的生活经历，出生地仍留空。

pairs.target: " àn wú yuánjí píngzhèng de nà yíxiàng sòngshěn . " tā shuō ,
pairs.english: “Submit it under the provision for people without proof of origin,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “按无原籍凭证的那一项送审。”她说，

pairs.target: " néng bunéng yòng , qǐng míngtiān de rén dāngmiàn shuō . "
pairs.english: “Let the people here tomorrow tell us in person whether it can be used.”
pairs.hanzi: “能不能用，请明天的人当面说。”

pairs.target: nǚrén fān dào guītiáo hòumiàn , zhǎo le yíhuìer , gěi tāmen yìzhāng huízhí .
pairs.english: The woman turned to the back of the regulations, searched for a while, and gave them a receipt.
pairs.hanzi: 女人翻到规条后面，找了一会儿，给他们一张回执。

pairs.target: " míngtiān xiàwǔ . bǎ yǎng nǐ de rén yě qǐnglái , ruò tā néng lái .
pairs.english: “Tomorrow afternoon. Please bring the person who raised you too, if she can come.
pairs.hanzi: “明天下午。把养你的人也请来，若她能来。

pairs.target: búshì jiào tā tì nǐ cāi chūshēngdì . "
pairs.english: We aren't asking her to guess your birthplace for you.”
pairs.hanzi: 不是叫她替你猜出生地。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng huízhí shōu hǎo , yòu zhǐ le zhǐ zuì shàngmiàn de nà zhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi put the receipt away safely, then pointed to the sheet on top.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将回执收好，又指了指最上面的那张纸。

pairs.target: " háikuǎn de biǎo , wǒmen méinádào . "
pairs.english: “We haven't received the repayment schedule.”
pairs.hanzi: “还款的表，我们没拿到。”

pairs.target: nǚrén jìxià , shuō huì xiàng shěnlǐ de rén yào qí .
pairs.english: The woman noted it down and said she would ask the reviewers for the complete set.
pairs.hanzi: 女人记下，说会向审理的人要齐。

alignment.english: ask the reviewers for the complete set

pairs.target: líkāi guìtái shí , nài lěi méiyǒu lìjí dài tā zǒu .
pairs.english: When they left the counter, Nerai did not take him away immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 离开柜台时，奈蕾没有立即带他走。

pairs.target: tā jiè le chuāng biān yìxiǎokuài zhuōmiàn , jiāng gāngcái huà de lù fàngzài tā miànqián .
pairs.english: She borrowed a little space on a table by the window and put the road he had just drawn in front of him.
pairs.hanzi: 她借了窗边一小块桌面，将刚才画的路放在他面前。

pairs.target: " chāo yífèn . wǎnghòu xiě huíjiā , xìnfēng shàng dé yǒu . "
pairs.english: “Copy it once. When you write home later, you'll need it on the envelope.”
pairs.hanzi: “抄一份。往后写回家，信封上得有。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wòbǐ de zīshì hái xiàng wò tàn tiáo ,
pairs.english: Tavi still held a pen as though he were holding a stick of charcoal;
pairs.hanzi: 塔维握笔的姿势还像握炭条，

pairs.target: dìyībǐ tàizhòng , mò zài zhǐ shàng yīn kāi .
pairs.english: his first stroke was too heavy, and ink bled across the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 第一笔太重，墨在纸上洇开。

pairs.target: tā tíngzhù , děng tā búzài kuò , cái jiēzhe xiě .
pairs.english: He stopped, waited until it spread no further, and only then continued writing.
pairs.hanzi: 他停住，等它不再扩，才接着写。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài pángbiān xiěchū záhuòpù de míngzì , ràng tā duì zhe chāo ,
pairs.english: Nerai wrote the grocery shop's name beside it for him to copy,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在旁边写出杂货铺的名字，让他对着抄，

pairs.target: yùdào rènbùdé de zì biàn niàn gěi tā tīng .
pairs.english: reading aloud to him whenever he met a character he did not recognize.
pairs.hanzi: 遇到认不得的字便念给他听。

pairs.target: tā xiě wán yìháng , shǒuzhǐ méiyǒu má , zhǐshì wànzǐ yǒuxiē suān .
pairs.english: He finished a line; his fingers were not numb, though his wrist ached a little.
pairs.hanzi: 他写完一行，手指没有麻，只是腕子有些酸。

pairs.target: tā jiāng shǒu fàng píng , shuǎi le shuǎi .
pairs.english: He flattened his hand and shook it out.
pairs.hanzi: 他将手放平，甩了甩。

pairs.target: chuāngwài tíng zhe yíliàng yùn xìn de xiǎochē .
pairs.english: A small mail cart stood outside the window.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外停着一辆运信的小车。

pairs.target: chēshàng guà zhe jǐzhī pídài , yìzhī dàikǒu fèng le liǎngdào lánxiàn , gēn biéde bùtóng .
pairs.english: Several leather bags hung on it; one had two blue lines stitched around its opening, unlike the others.
pairs.hanzi: 车上挂着几只皮袋，一只袋口缝了两道蓝线，跟别的不同。

pairs.target: " nàge sòng nǎér ? "
pairs.english: “Where does that one go?”
pairs.hanzi: “那个送哪儿？”

pairs.target: nài lěi shùnzhe tā de mùguāng kàn guòqù .
pairs.english: Nerai followed his gaze.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾顺着他的目光看过去。

pairs.target: " xībiān . dào shānkǒu zài huànrén . "
pairs.english: “West. They change carriers at the mountain pass.”
pairs.hanzi: “西边。到山口再换人。”

pairs.target: " yě sòngdào shān wài ? "
pairs.english: “Do they deliver beyond the mountains too?”
pairs.hanzi: “也送到山外？”

pairs.target: " yǒu de sòng . yǒu de dìfāng zhī suí shāngduì dài , kàn shuíkěn zǒu nàtiáo lù . "
pairs.english: “Some do. Some places only get mail with caravans, depending on who is willing to take that road.”
pairs.hanzi: “有的送。有的地方只随商队带，看谁肯走那条路。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ tā xuēzǐ shàng de ní , yě xiǎngqǐ nàxiē huàxiàng .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the mud on her boots, and those portraits too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起她靴子上的泥，也想起那些画像。

pairs.target: huà shàng zǒngshì yígè rén , yípiàn kōngshān ,
pairs.english: The pictures always showed one person and a stretch of empty mountains,
pairs.hanzi: 画上总是一个人、一片空山，

pairs.target: méiyǒu shuí tí zhe yídài yào sòngdào biérén shǒulǐ de xìn .
pairs.english: never anyone carrying a bag of letters that needed to reach other people's hands.
pairs.hanzi: 没有谁提着一袋要送到别人手里的信。

pairs.target: " nàlǐ yě yǒurén děng xìn ? "
pairs.english: “People wait for letters there too?”
pairs.hanzi: “那里也有人等信？”

pairs.target: nài lěi cóng zhuōshàng jiǎnqǐ yìxiǎopiàn fèizhǐ , zhé chéng sìfāng .
pairs.english: Nerai picked a small scrap of waste paper off the table and folded it into a square.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾从桌上捡起一小片废纸，折成四方。

pairs.target: " wǒ rènshi yìjiārén , zhù zài dī dì de yíchù shípō .
pairs.english: “I know a family living on a rocky slope in the lowlands.
pairs.hanzi: “我认识一家人，住在低地的一处石坡。

pairs.target: tāmen měicì tuō wǒ dài dōngxī , dì yīyàng dōu shì zhēn .
pairs.english: Whenever they ask me to bring things, the first item is always needles.
pairs.hanzi: 他们每次托我带东西，第一样都是针。

pairs.target: búshì dāo , yě búshì hùshēnfú , shì néng chuān xìxiàn de zhēn . "
pairs.english: Not knives or protective charms: needles that can take fine thread.”
pairs.hanzi: 不是刀，也不是护身符，是能穿细线的针。”

pairs.target: " zìjǐ zuòbùliǎo ? "
pairs.english: “Can't they make their own?”
pairs.hanzi: “自己做不了？”

pairs.target: " néng zuò cū de . xì de bùhǎo zuò .
pairs.english: “They can make coarse ones. Fine ones are hard to make.
pairs.hanzi: “能做粗的。细的不好做。

pairs.target: tāmen yǒu yìzhǒng bù , fèng dé cū le huì lòushuǐ , gài wūdǐng yě yòng . "
pairs.english: They have a cloth that leaks if stitched too coarsely. They use it for roofing too.”
pairs.hanzi: 他们有一种布，缝得粗了会漏水，盖屋顶也用。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhézhǐ fàngzài tā huà de ménpáng , xiàng tiān le yìjiān xiǎowū .
pairs.english: She put the folded paper beside the door he had drawn, as though adding a little house.
pairs.hanzi: 她把折纸放在他画的门旁，像添了一间小屋。

pairs.target: " yǒu huí wǒ dài cuò le . tāmen ràng wǒ zuòzài ménkǒu chuān le yí xiàwǔ xiàn , cái zhīdào chà zài nǎlǐ . "
pairs.english: “Once I brought the wrong ones. They had me sit in the doorway threading needles all afternoon before I understood the difference.”
pairs.hanzi: “有回我带错了。他们让我坐在门口穿了一下午线，才知道差在哪里。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yíxià , dītóu kàn zìjǐ shǒuzhōng de bǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed briefly, then looked down at the pen in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一下，低头看自己手中的笔。

pairs.target: yuánlái tā dào le shān wài , yě yǒu zuòbùlái de shì ,
pairs.english: So even beyond the mountains, there were things she could not do,
pairs.hanzi: 原来她到了山外，也有做不来的事，

pairs.target: yě yǒurén děng tā bǎ dōngxī dài duì .
pairs.english: and people waiting for her to bring the right things.
pairs.hanzi: 也有人等她把东西带对。

pairs.target: " nà shípō zài dìtú shàng ma ? "
pairs.english: “Is that rocky slope on the map?”
pairs.hanzi: “那石坡在地图上吗？”

pairs.target: qiángshàng jiù guà zhe yìzhāng lù tú .
pairs.english: A route map hung right there on the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 墙上就挂着一张路图。

pairs.target: shānkǒu yǐxī de xiàn zǒu dào zhǐbiān ,
pairs.english: The line west of the pass ran to the edge of the paper;
pairs.hanzi: 山口以西的线走到纸边，

pairs.target: xiàmiàn yí dàpiàn zhī tú zhe dànhuī , méiyǒu wūzi , yě méiyǒu lù míng .
pairs.english: a large area below was shaded only pale gray, with no houses or road names.
pairs.hanzi: 下面一大片只涂着淡灰，没有屋子，也没有路名。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhàn qǐlái , zhǐxiàng huīsè lǐ dàgài de yíchù , méiyǒu pèngdào zhǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai stood and pointed roughly to a spot in the gray, without touching the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾站起来，指向灰色里大概的一处，没有碰到纸。

pairs.target: " wǒ zǒuguò de tú shàng yǒu . zhè zhāng méiyǒu .
pairs.english: “It's on the maps I've traveled by. This one doesn't have it.
pairs.hanzi: “我走过的图上有。这张没有。

pairs.target: tā zhǐguǎn bǎ huò sòngdào huànchē de dìfāng . "
pairs.english: This only covers getting freight to where they change carts.”
pairs.hanzi: 它只管把货送到换车的地方。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng le piànkè , cái huídào zhuōqián .
pairs.english: Tavi looked for a moment before returning to the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望了片刻，才回到桌前。

pairs.target: tā zài dìzhǐ xiàmiàn xiě sè lā de míngzì ,
pairs.english: He wrote Sela's name below the address,
pairs.hanzi: 他在地址下面写瑟拉的名字，

pairs.target: xiě dào zuìhòu yìbǐ , fāxiàn pángbiān nà jiān zhǐ zhé de xiǎowū dǎngzhù le wèizhì .
pairs.english: and at the final stroke found the little folded-paper house beside it was in the way.
pairs.hanzi: 写到最后一笔，发现旁边那间纸折的小屋挡住了位置。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xiǎowū nuókāi , méiyǒu rēng .
pairs.english: He moved the little house aside, but did not throw it away.
pairs.hanzi: 他把小屋挪开，没有扔。

pairs.target: huíqù yǐqián , nài lěi ràng tā zìjǐ dú yíbiàn dìzhǐ .
pairs.english: Before they left, Nerai had him read the address himself once.
pairs.hanzi: 回去以前，奈蕾让他自己读一遍地址。

pairs.target: tā dú dé màn , záhuòpù de míngzì háiyào kàn tā de kǒuxíng ,
pairs.english: He read slowly, still needing to watch her lips for the grocery shop's name,
pairs.hanzi: 他读得慢，杂货铺的名字还要看她的口形，

pairs.target: dú dào " zhuǎnjiāo sè lā " shí què méiyǒu tíng .
pairs.english: but did not pause when he reached “Please pass to Sela.”
pairs.hanzi: 读到“转交瑟拉”时却没有停。

pairs.target: tā jiāng dìzhǐ hé míngtiān de huízhí fēnkāi fàngjìn bùdài .
pairs.english: He put the address and tomorrow's receipt separately into his cloth bag.
pairs.hanzi: 他将地址和明天的回执分开放进布袋。

pairs.target: yìzhāng yào dàihuíjiā gěi sè lā kàn , lìng yìzhāng yǐhòu yěxǔ néng zìjǐ zhǎodào huíjiā de lù .
pairs.english: One he would take home for Sela to see; the other might someday find its own way home.
pairs.hanzi: 一张要带回家给瑟拉看，另一张以后也许能自己找到回家的路。
